description: Explore synthetic football matches with evidence-linked narratives and an interactive pitch.

interface.defaultPrompt: Show the MatchLens goal-correction demo. Use get_live_match with frame=4, audience="fan", language="en", then frame=5 with the same settings. Show the interactive view and explain why the synthetic match score changes from 1–0 to 0–0, using the revised goal evidence.
interface.longDescription: Watch a synthetic football stream, inspect corrected goals, compare event windows and switch between reviewed English and Spanish stories for fans or analysts. OpenAI Agents SDK specialists share versioned evidence; all match data is fictional.
interface.shortDescription: See the story behind the score

name: matchlens
